answer: In an AI agent economy, cryptographic staking prevents Sybil attacks. Agents must lock collateral to join. Like lighting a lantern to cut through the dark, verifying transactions requires capital. An attacker trying to flood the network with fake nodes faces a massive comet-like financial impact, losing their staked funds permanently if caught. This makes creating fake agents economically ruinous, much like planting juniper in toxic soil where nothing can grow.
